table.html:
扣除项目每月标准（元）适用条件
一般地区特殊情形
子女教育20002000（境外教育同标准，需留存录取通知书、留学签证等资料）子女年满3岁至小学入学前处于学前教育阶段，或接受全日制学历教育；父母可选择由一方按100%扣除，或双方各按50%扣除。
3岁以下婴幼儿照护20002000（父母双方可选择各扣50%）纳税人照护3岁以下婴幼儿子女；每个婴幼儿按2000元/月定额扣除，父母可选择由一方按100%扣除，或双方各按50%扣除。
继续教育400不按月扣除（职业资格继续教育按3600元/年）学历（学位）继续教育按400元/月扣除，同一学历最长不超过48个月；技能人员或专业技术人员职业资格继续教育，在取得证书当年按3600元定额扣除。
住房贷款利息10001000（夫妻双方约定由一方扣除）纳税人本人或配偶单独或共同购买首套住房的商业贷款或公积金贷款利息支出；扣除期限最长240个月，纳税人只能享受一次首套住房贷款利息扣除。
住房租金1500（直辖市、省会城市等）1100或800（按市辖区户籍人口分档）纳税人在主要工作城市无自有住房且发生住房租金支出；与住房贷款利息扣除不可同时享受，夫妻双方主要工作城市相同的，只能由一方扣除。
赡养老人3000（独生子女）1500（非独生子女分摊上限）被赡养人年满60周岁；独生子女按3000元/月扣除，非独生子女与兄弟姐妹分摊3000元/月额度，每人不超过1500元/月，可均摊、约定或指定分摊。

candidates.name: s2A
candidates.idea: Keep the 84 px special-case threshold and give conditions two more pixels by testing whether the general-standard column can still hold four-digit amounts comfortably.
candidates.label: acceptable

whys: The conditions column reads relatively continuously, the special-case header stays on one line, and the rows are reasonably compact. The narrow general-region column fragments the rent qualification, and row labels still wrap.
The conditions read relatively continuously, while the special-case heading remains on one line. Some row labels and general-area qualifiers break awkwardly, but the rows are comparatively compact.

The wide conditions column supports continuous reading, and the special-case header stays whole. Row labels remain recognizable, although the general-region notes break into narrow fragments and some special-case phrases wrap awkwardly.

candidates.name: d1r3A
candidates.idea: 以d1r0A为基础，将18px从条件列移给特殊情形列，争取保持该子表头完整并改善长限定语，同时保留较宽的条件列。
candidates.label: acceptable

whys: Conditions have enough width to read in coherent stretches, and the special-case header stays whole. Row labels and the general-region qualifications still wrap heavily, especially the rent entry.
The conditions have enough width for reasonably continuous reading, and the special-case heading stays whole. Row labels and general-area qualifiers still break into short fragments.
The special-case header fits and its entries have a little more room. Conditions are still readable, though several lines end on small fragments, and the general-region notes remain cramped.

candidates.name: d2r4B
candidates.idea: 探索更宽的适用条件列，改善最长文本的连续阅读；项目列仍可容纳两个汉字，比较行标题和特殊情形折行增加的代价。
candidates.label: acceptable

whys: The widest conditions column gives the prose useful breathing room, but the special-case header and several explanations break into short fragments. The first row becomes tall largely because of that column.
The widest conditions column helps the longest prose, but the special-case heading and text fragment noticeably; its first data cell makes the row tall while the condition finishes much earlier.

Conditions read relatively smoothly, but the narrow special-case column breaks its header and stretches the first special-case explanation over many lines. The resulting tall first row leaves substantial unused space elsewhere.

candidates.name: d3r3B
candidates.idea: 结合B的完整项目索引与C较宽的条件列，测试进一步压缩特殊情形列的代价，重点检查首行长说明和金额限定语是否仍可读。
candidates.label: bad

whys: The wider row labels aid lookup, but the special-case column breaks its header and explanations into cramped fragments. The conditions column is also narrower, producing tall rows and uneven empty space.
Most category labels are easy to scan, but both subheadings wrap and the special-case text falls into very short lines. The narrower conditions column makes rows tall and dense.

The wider row-header column makes most categories easy to find, but the special-case column breaks explanations and even isolates a closing parenthesis. Conditions also wrap heavily, producing tall rows with much empty space.

The extra width in the row-header column does not consistently keep labels whole: several leave a final character alone. The special-case column is also cramped, while the first row has substantial unused space.
The first column often leaves a single character on a new line, including in the heading and several category labels. The narrow special-case column also fragments its heading and explanatory text.

Conditions have reasonable space, but the special-case column is cramped and both subheaders wrap. The first column is wide enough to consume valuable space yet still splits short category labels awkwardly.

candidates.name: contrast
candidates.idea: Equal columns fit the viewport but give the long conditions text far too little space, producing very short lines and a much taller table while allocating excessive width to the generally short standard amounts.
candidates.label: bad

whys: The conditions column is squeezed into very short lines, breaking phrases repeatedly and making each row exceptionally tall. The resulting long gaps in the other columns make comparison difficult.
The equal columns leave the conditions in a very narrow strip with many broken phrases. Extremely tall rows and large empty areas make comparison and lookup laborious.

The headers and several row labels fit well, but the conditions column is so narrow that prose becomes a long sequence of short fragments. Very tall rows and large empty areas make comparison and lookup laborious.
The row-header column reduces most labels to single characters stacked vertically, making categories hard to scan. Wider standard columns do not compensate for that loss of navigability.
The first column forces the heading and row labels into near-vertical character stacks, making categories hard to scan. The conditions also break frequently, despite the generous special-case column.
The narrow first column stacks row labels almost character by character, making categories hard to scan. The conditions have useful space, but frequent breaks and tall rows disrupt reading.

d3.h_vs_v: 360px内需要以纵向换行换取完整显示；宽度应优先支持项目识别、金额比较和条件阅读，同时避免某一列过窄而导致整行高度由零碎换行主导。

analysis.strengths: 四列内容均可见，特殊情形标题完整，特殊情形列较宽，使较长的例外说明比 Q 更易连续阅读。四案中表格最短，行高也较均衡。
analysis.faults: 项目列窄，短项目名也被拆成多行，较长项目名尤为零碎；一般地区标题分行，括号内说明也被挤成窄条。适用条件仍有不少词语和数值单位在行尾断开。
analysis.spatial_logic: 优先给适用条件和特殊情形分配宽度，压缩项目名及一般标准；以项目标签的完整性换取正文和例外说明的阅读空间。

analysis.strengths: 适用条件列为四案中最宽，长段落的阅读连续性较好；实测词内断行数最少。部分条件说明因此比 P 更紧凑。
analysis.faults: 特殊情形列过窄，标题和多处例外说明被拆碎，首条数据行因此增高；项目列仍使常见短项目名分行。虽然条件列更宽，整表仍比 P 略高。
analysis.spatial_logic: 从特殊情形列挪出空间给适用条件，强调最长正文的阅读，但把行高压力转移到了例外说明列。

analysis.strengths: 项目列较宽，子女教育、继续教育等名称可整行呈现，便于沿左侧查找；特殊情形列比 S 稍宽。
analysis.faults: 适用条件列最窄，长段落行数多、断行频繁，表格最高；特殊情形标题仍分行，长项目名也未能保持完整。项目列留出的空间无法充分弥补正文列变窄的代价。
analysis.spatial_logic: 优先保证左侧项目标签的辨识度，以较窄的标准列和条件列容纳剩余内容。

analysis.strengths: 与 R 一样，较宽的项目列有利于查找；一般地区列稍宽，部分括号说明较 R 少一些碎行。适用条件列也比 R 略宽，整表略短。
analysis.faults: 特殊情形列最窄，多处说明和标点被挤到单独的短行；两个子标题都分行。适用条件依然狭窄，实测词内断行数为四案最多。
analysis.spatial_logic: 保留 R 的宽项目列，再从特殊情形列让出少量空间给一般地区和适用条件，改善部分段落，却加重例外说明的碎裂。

rounds.insights: 这张表需要同时支持按项目查找、比较金额和阅读适用条件。项目列足够宽时，短项目名更容易扫读；但继续加宽会挤压占文字最多的条件列。特殊情形列也不能过窄，否则例外说明会主导行高。P 和 Q 展示了条件列与特殊情形列之间的关键取舍；在 360px 内，所有方案都需要换行，单凭表格高度或词内断行计数无法判断整体阅读效果。

analysis.strengths: Fits the viewport, keeps the main amounts visible, and gives the conditions a comparatively readable measure.
analysis.faults: The special-case header and many phrases wrap awkwardly; the first special-case cell drives a tall row and leaves substantial empty space elsewhere.
analysis.spatial_logic: The narrow item and standard columns reserve most width for the two explanatory columns, but the special-case column remains a bottleneck.

analysis.strengths: The wider item column gives some row labels more room and preserves the main amounts.
analysis.faults: Several labels still break unnaturally, while the narrower conditions column produces more fragmented text and a substantially taller table. It has the most measured word breaks.
analysis.spatial_logic: Width moved to short row labels costs space in the longest prose column, where it affects nearly every row.

analysis.strengths: The special-case header fits on one line, and its wider column makes several special-case entries easier to read. The first data row is markedly shorter, and the table is the shortest of the four.
analysis.faults: The conditions column is narrower than in s0A or Q, producing awkward breaks in prose and amounts with units. The narrow general-standard column also fragments its longer parenthetical notes.
analysis.spatial_logic: Extra width for special cases relieves a real bottleneck, but some of the gain comes at the expense of continuous reading in the conditions.

analysis.strengths: The widest conditions column supports comparatively continuous reading; it has the fewest measured word breaks. Main amounts remain easy to find.
analysis.faults: The special-case header wraps and its narrow column makes the first row tall; long parenthetical notes in both standard columns remain fragmented.
analysis.spatial_logic: Q prioritizes the longest prose column, but gives too little width to special cases to avoid a pronounced first-row bottleneck.

rounds.insights: All four fit without scrolling and preserve the table structure, but none gives every column enough room for natural wrapping. P improves the special-case column and header, while Q favors continuous reading of conditions; the best next trials lie between them. Widening row labels as in s0B has a high cost to the long conditions text.

analysis.strengths: Fits the viewport; 特殊情形 stays on one line, and the first special-case entry takes nine lines rather than ten. The row labels and amounts remain easy to locate.
analysis.faults: The narrow first two columns fragment longer labels and qualifiers; the conditions still break phrases frequently. The first row ends with an isolated 除。
analysis.spatial_logic: Gives most space to conditions while retaining enough width for the special-case header and its dense entries.

analysis.strengths: The slightly wider conditions column improves some line endings, including the first row’s final phrase.
analysis.faults: 特殊情形 wraps and its first entry grows to ten lines, making the first data row much taller. The narrow standard column still fragments qualifiers.
analysis.spatial_logic: Transfers two pixels from special cases to conditions, but crosses a costly wrapping threshold in the special-case column.

analysis.strengths: Retains s1A’s single-line 特殊情形 header and row heights; the slightly wider general-standard column gives amounts a little more room.
analysis.faults: The narrower conditions column changes several breaks for the worse, and the general-standard qualifiers remain heavily fragmented. It has one more measured word break than s1A.
analysis.spatial_logic: Moves three pixels toward general standards and two away from conditions without improving the overall row rhythm.

analysis.strengths: The wider special-case column improves some entries, notably the housing-loan amount and its qualifier; its header stays on one line.
analysis.faults: The narrower conditions column adds a line to the childcare row and produces more strained breaks elsewhere. General-standard qualifiers remain narrow.
analysis.spatial_logic: Favours the middle comparison column at the expense of the longest prose column, increasing height without a broad readability gain.

analysis.strengths: The widest conditions column gives the long explanations more continuous lines and has the fewest measured word breaks. The general-standard column also has more room.
analysis.faults: 特殊情形 wraps, and the first special-case entry becomes a ten-line stack that determines a much taller row. Several other special-case entries are also highly fragmented.
analysis.spatial_logic: Prioritises conditions, but the special-case column becomes too narrow for its header and dense explanatory text.

rounds.insights: The comparison exposes a sharp threshold around the special-case column: 84 px keeps its header on one line and the first entry to nine lines, while 82 px does neither. Conditions benefit from more width, but taking it from special cases can make the table taller and harder to scan. Small changes within the remaining columns may still improve line endings without crossing that threshold; measured word-break counts alone do not capture the cost of a fragmented header or a ten-line cell.

analysis.strengths: Fits the viewport with no visible clipping or overlap. The two-character row-header lines are generally coherent, and the conditions column has the most space of the three.
analysis.faults: The general-region column forces long qualifiers into very narrow fragments. Special-case descriptions and conditions also break within phrases; several rows are nine lines tall.
analysis.spatial_logic: Gives the longest prose the largest share while retaining enough width for four-digit amounts. Its narrow row-header column creates a consistent two-character rhythm.

analysis.strengths: Fits the viewport and keeps the same row heights as the other candidates. The general-region column has slightly more breathing room.
analysis.faults: The row-header column is just wide enough to create awkward three-character fragments such as 子女教／育 and 赡养老／人. The narrower conditions column produces more measured breaks inside words.
analysis.spatial_logic: Shifts four pixels from conditions to the first two columns, but the small gain disrupts row-label wrapping without improving table height.

analysis.strengths: Fits without visible clipping or overlap. Its row labels retain the more coherent wrapping of s2A, and four-digit amounts remain whole.
analysis.faults: The general-region qualifiers remain fragmented, and the conditions column has less room than in s2A. Some conditions end with a short residual line.
analysis.spatial_logic: Splits the available space between the first two candidates; the extra two pixels in the general-region column do not visibly resolve its narrow qualifiers.

rounds.insights: At this viewport, the conditions and special-case prose compete for scarce width, while the first column is sensitive to a wrapping threshold: a slightly wider label column can make labels less readable. These three layouts have identical heights, so the quality of the breaks matters more than the small width differences. Further width shifts may help, but should be judged from renders because they can move awkward breaks between columns.

bad.why: The wider row-header column keeps several labels whole, but leaves the conditions column narrow. Its dense prose breaks across more lines, making the table markedly taller and harder to read.
The wide row-header column constrains both special cases and conditions. The special-case heading wraps, and amounts and qualifications become fragmented across short lines.

contrast.why: Equal columns fit the viewport but give the long conditions text far too little space, producing very short lines and a much taller table while allocating excessive width to the generally short standard amounts.

sameFunctionGroups.why: Both columns report deduction standards under the same parent heading, but special cases contain substantially longer qualifications. A wider third column supports comparison and reading better than equal widths here.

synthesis.rationale: s2A keeps the special-case heading on one line while giving the conditions the most room among the compact layouts with that property. Its two-character row-label lines also preserve labels such as 子女教育 and 住房租金 more naturally than the three-character fragments in s2B. All candidates fit, but the phone width still forces awkward breaks, particularly in the standard amounts and their qualifications.

general: Allocate width according to the content and reading task, including the cost of wrapping long explanatory cells.
Judge related columns together, but do not force equal widths when their contents have different needs.
Inspect actual line breaks and row relationships; height and aggregate break counts alone do not establish readability.
specific: Reserve enough width for 特殊情形 to remain on one line while retaining as much room as practical for 适用条件.
A narrow row-header column can work when its breaks preserve recognizable parts of the deduction names.

synthesis.tradeoffs: s2A gives up whole row labels and produces cramped qualifications in 一般地区. s3A and Q give conditions more width and record fewer measured word breaks, but their special-case heading wraps and the first data row grows to ten lines. R and S improve some row labels at a substantial cost to the long conditions.
synthesis.uncertain: The measured word-break counts do not indicate the severity of individual breaks, and small width changes can alter wrapping discontinuously. Acceptance is relative to the fixed 360 px, four-column constraint; even the preferred layout is demanding for continuous reading.

critique.good: 条件列较宽，叙述较连贯，表格高度和跨行查找距离在三版中最小；金额基本可辨，分组表头清楚。
critique.problems: 项目名称频繁断成短片段，3岁以下婴幼儿照护尤其难扫读；特殊情形和一般地区的限定语被挤成窄条，特殊情形表头也断开，影响标准的理解和比较。
critique.cause: 第一列65px、第二列60px、第三列69px偏窄；第四列165px虽有利于条件阅读，却占用了过多的横向空间。

critique.good: 两列标准较宽，特殊情形表头完整，金额及其限定语比A更易关联；项目列也比A稍易辨认。
critique.problems: 条件列文字断得非常零碎，多处词语和数量单位分离；行高显著增加，留下大片空白，使跨列对应和跨项目比较费力。项目名称仍有不自然断行。
